text:
zoe: Hey design team — prepping assets for Apr 8 webinar 'Serving Wins' and benchmark blog. Need a compact set of visuals: 1) benchmark hero (web + 1200x628), 2) 3 comparison sparklines, 3) one-pager PDF slide, 4) social carousel frames (1080x1080). Brand constraints: use blue gradient, secondary accent #FFB84D, and accessible typography. Deadline: EOD Apr 2 for first pass. Any capacity?
liam: Hi! We can do hero + 3 sparklines. need copy and raw numbers for charts. who owns the benchmark CSV?
noah: I have the CSV (link: https://figma.com/file/benchmark-data) — it's the latency/cost by model run. I'll drop a clean spreadsheet in drive. Also want a visual that shows 'unit cost' callout.
ada: copy for hero: "Redwood Inference — predictable latency, lower unit costs". Social caption draft: "We benchmark common LLM workloads to help you choose the right serving strategy. Webinar Apr 8. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar". Can someone shorten for twitter?
marc: Legal: keep claims factual, avoid 'cheapest' without context. Add small-footnote area for methodology link. Also CC @legal-review.
liam: Noted — we'll include footer: "See methodology" + small link. For accessibility, prefer 4.5:1 contrast. Can we get brand color hex for background gradient start/end?
zoe: gradient start #0057FF, end #6BCBFF. Accent #FFB84D. Use Inter or system UI. Alt text examples needed for each social card.
noah: alt text: "Chart comparing latency vs cost across four models; Redwood Inference reduces per-token spend through batching and caching." Short tweet: "How to lower LLM unit cost without raising latency — webinar Apr 8. Register: <link>" 
liam: timeline: mockups by Apr 1, review Apr 2, final assets Apr 4. Does that work?
ada: Apr 1 mockups good. Also need localized banners for EMEA (English + French). small tweak to CTA on EU: "Join (EMEA friendly time)".
marc: Will legal need to review final copy? yes, please @legal-review on the final upload. Also include dataset methodology link in slide notes.
design-bot: Reminder — upload Figma file to /Marketing/Webinars/ServingWins and tag #brand-check when ready.
zoe: Can you add a compact version (600x314) for blog header? And an infographic tile that visualizes batching->cost drop (single frame).
liam: Yes to 600x314. For infographic we'll do a single long PNG and a 1200x1200 tile. Need the raw numbers for the cost drop callout (noah pls).
noah: Dropping spreadsheet now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/benchmark-april. Also added sample SVG of the KV cache icon to use in the infographic.
ada: For copy variants — 1) full hero; 2) short slide headline; 3) social short. I'll paste in the three variants into the figma copy layer.
zoe: Great — if design can slot the mockups by Apr 1 I'll coordinate a quick all-hands review Apr 2 @10:00am PT. Marking priority: high (webinar funnel feed). :rocket:
liam: Got it. tagging design ops for bandwidth. Any blockers?
marc: Legal will do quick sweep Apr 3. No blockers from my side.
ada: Tiny ask: can we A/B test two hero headlines? I'll create A/B copy and drop here tomorrow.
noah: one more: include a small 'Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private' legend in the infographic.
liam: Cool. I'll create initial frames and post Figma link by EOD Apr 1. 
zoe: thanks all — cc @growth to sync on registration landing updates. :thumbsup:
